title: Transitrix canon candidate (ingest)
description: A typed canon CANDIDATE proposed by the ingest pipeline — an element or a relation. A candidate is never canon: it carries admitted_to: pending and is gated by a human via the review queue. It cites its field source via derived_from, and carries extraction_confidence as a review flag that is kept strictly separate from the source's source_quality and is never persisted into canon.

kind.description: Whether this candidate is an element or a typed relation.

derived_from.description: Typed IDs of the field artefact(s) this candidate was derived from (CONTRACT.md §6). A citation, never a migration. At least one is required for a candidate.

admitted_to.description: A candidate is always pending. The human admission gate completes admission; this skill never sets it to `canon`.

extraction_confidence.description: Review flag — did the model read the document correctly. SEPARATE from source_quality (CONTRACT.md §11.8); surfaced in the review queue; never folded into source_quality; never persisted into canon.

extraction_notes.description: Ambiguities, contradictions, or judgement calls the human reviewer should resolve.

coverage_flag.description: Set when the candidate's TYPE / REL kind falls outside the adopter's active coverage_profile (COVERAGE_PROFILES.md). Out-of-profile candidates are flagged, not silently emitted into canon nor silently dropped.

validation_flags.description: Actionable reasons a candidate did not validate cleanly (ID grammar, TYPE registry, closed REL kinds, lifecycle). Each flag routes the candidate to the review queue rather than rejecting it.

element_type.description: Canonical element TYPE (IDS_AND_REFERENCES.md §3.1), e.g. FACTOR, GOAL, ROLE, APPLICATION.

valid_from.description: Lifecycle anchor (CONTRACT.md §7). `pending` or a date when known.

oneOf.title: Relation candidate
oneOf.description: Relations are the risky part: only emitted as a candidate above a high confidence threshold (v0 is relation-conservative). Below-threshold relations are review-queue suggestions, not candidates.

rel_kind.description: A closed REL kind from the relations registry (17-relations.md). Never invented.

from.description: Source endpoint — a candidate or canonical element ID.

to.description: Target endpoint — a candidate or canonical element ID.
